notes: Fixes 2.13.0, which could not get past its own start screen. If the app has been sitting on the four green ticks with no way in, this is the fix — not your machine.
The usage strip now shows your REAL plan usage: the same percentage the CLI gives you for /usage, plus when each window resets. That is the number that says whether a run you start now will finish.
The token counts beside it still come from your own machine and still include your terminal sessions. Hover either figure for the breakdown and where the reading came from.
If you sign in with an API key rather than a subscription, or you are offline, the strip falls back to the old comparison and says why.
